thread:
leo_sales: Heads up 12pm demo prospect (CareLoop) just asked for compliance artifacts to move the deal: SOC2 Type II redacted, ISO27001 cert, and a short pen-test attestation that shows scope and date. They want it attached to the SOW by Wednesday. Also asked if providing these docs triggers any POC fee changes. tagging @anya_se @rachel_security @ivan_legal

anya_se: POC is on hosted sandbox with standard tenancy. Sharing redacted artifacts shouldn't affect POC pricing. If they require dedicated hosts or on-prem deployment that's priced separately.

rachel_security: We can prepare a redacted SOC2 report (controls and attestation only), ISO27001 certificate, and a one-page pen-test attestation. Attestation will state: test date, scope (external web app + network perimeter), and that full findings are available only under NDA. I can sign it as Acting CISO. ETA: 48 hours to compile and sign.

ivan_legal: Confirmed. Standard one-way NDA + limited-use clause acceptable for sharing pen-test attestation. If they request raw findings we need a signed NDA, a data handling addendum, and exec approval. I'll drop the NDA template in the shared folder.

leo_sales: They also asked if we can mark the SOC2 as "for procurement evaluation only" and redact control IDs if needed. OK to do, @rachel_security?

rachel_security: Yes. We'll redact PII and internal ticket IDs and add a cover page: "redacted for vendor evaluation". We'll include a sanitized architecture sketch for the POC to show data residency.

anya_se: Can someone provide a short procurement-safe line I can paste into their system? They want explicit "no cost change" language.

ivan_legal: Suggested one-liner: "Redwood Inference confirms that providing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation will not change the quoted POC fees; any requested changes to hosting or support entitlements may be quoted separately." Short version: "Providing redacted compliance artifacts will not change POC fees."

leo_sales: Perfect. Please upload when ready and ping me. Deadline Wed COB.

upload_bot: Upload queued to secure bucket: gs://redwood-evidence/procurements/1774456789/ (restricted access). Files to be uploaded: SOC2-Redacted-ControlsOnly-2024.pdf, ISO27001-Cert-Redacted.pdf, PenTest-Attestation-Rachel-signed.pdf, POC-Architecture-Sanitized.pdf, Evidence-Cover-Note.pdf

rachel_security: Uploaded and shared with sales/legal/compliance. Link sent to @leo_sales. Marking as ready to attach to SOW.

leo_sales: Sent to CareLoop procurement. They acknowledged receipt and said it satisfies their checklist. They signed the NDA for the attestation. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
